Hi Miriam — thanks for the details and the floor plan. Short answers up front:
- Consolidate audio routing via a single Dante-enabled core is preferred for easier channel routing and redundancy, but you should provision two independent switches (L2 redundant) and a small edge router that can NAT to your SIP appliance for the secure bridge.
- Sonic AV (local) has done the Franklin Center three-room setups before; copying Jesse Park to loop them in.
- For RF: plan two separate RF banks with staggered frequency sets and reserve one spare lav channel per room. We recommend wired backup channels to the interpreter stations.

Proposed next steps:
1) Jesse/AV to send a short equipment manifest + quote.
2) Redwood onsite tech (Marcus) to do a 60-min site walk with Sonic on Nov 12 (AM). Marcus — can you confirm availability?
3) InterpreterCo to confirm encoder/decoder requirements for the live feed and any preferred channel counts.

I attached a quick audio-channel skeleton (first pass). Will follow up with travel needs for Marcus and Hannah (if we need two techs).
